regime_filter_definition: BTC daily SMA200 trend, causal at D-1 close: bull if close>sma200 and sma200 rising over 20d; bear if close<sma200 and sma200 falling; chop otherwise; unknown if <221 daily closes. See research/regime.py.
cycle1_knowledge_statement: Cycle-1 NO_CANDIDATE (regime dependence) motivated the new XSR family and the regime-stratified gate, declared here a priori. No cycle-2 configuration was selected or tuned from cycle-1 validation/OOS metrics. Cycle-1 trials remain in the cumulative trial log.
